notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE #3 | CONFIRMED CRASHING ISSUES FIX, VHS FILTER AND MORE...
notes.content:
After a week of research, headaches, and frustration, I have finally identified the source of crashes, memory leaks, and high memory usage. The culprit was the "latest" facial motion capture technology released by Epic Games called Metahuman Animator.

Safest solution to use, was to remove the facial animations and replace them with a popular face censorship effect, which has resulted in no more crashes and significantly lower GPU temperatures and memory usage. 

[b]Thank you for your patience. I hope this solution FINALLY fixed your issues.[/b]

[b][u]Additionally, as an apology for this very unpleasant issue, I have added a very atmospheric VHS filter along with appropriate sound effect. You can enable and disable it in the main menu and on the pause screen.[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021401/9c686bc0a02ad5d0e9c1608992e4fa20c4ae3d68.png[/img]

[i][u]- 100% fixed crashing before the cutscene with the Sheriff.
- 100% fixed crashing before the initial cutscene with a client.
- Reduced memory usage, CPU and GPU temperatures during cutscenes and gameplay.
- Added VHS filter along with the appropriate sound effect for it.[/u][/i]

[b][h2][url=discord.gg/Xfd9RDecTp]JOIN DISCORD[/url][/h2][/b]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE #2 | SHERIFF CUTSCENE CRASH FIX, OPTIMIZATION AND MORE...
notes.content:
There's no such thing as a break. 

I'm coming back to you with what is probably the most eagerly awaited update. I believe I've finally managed to fix the game's crashing issues, especially the crash before the cutscene with the sheriff. I've made some improvements to the voice recognition and fixed a few minor issues. I hope this helps.

[i]- Fixed crashing before the cutscene with the Sheriff.
- Fixed crashing before the initial cutscene with a client.
- Reduced memory usage during cutscenes.
- Locked cutscenes to 60fps to reduce memory leakage and the usage of GPU and CPU.
- Improved voice recognition commands and made it clearer how to use them by adding a widget that explains them when you open the game.
- Prevented being attacked or using the microphone meter during the cutscene with the Sheriff.
- Fixed an error where, after completing the fuses puzzle, the game still didn't recognize that you finished it when asked, "Can you help me?".[/i]

[h2][url=https://discord.gg/Xfd9RDecTp]JOIN DISCORD[/url][/h2]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE #1 | FIX CRASHES, PERFOMANCE, MICROPHONE CALIBRATION AND MORE...
notes.content:
[b]Hi,


I'm bringing you a pretty big update in which I've fixed a lot of issues. Thanks to your feedback on Discord, I was able to improve many things, and I hope this significant update will help you.[/b]


[i]- Optimized and improved perfomance on the entire level and improved LOD of some 3D models to ensure a higher frame rate.

- Added microphone configuration option in the pause menu next to the Discord icon.

- Added a game launch option to maximize your experience. If you have any issues with the game or it crashes, select the DirectX11 option when launching the game. If you have a powerful computer and no issues with the game, select DirectX12.

- Optimized microphone settings to reduce noise detection and focus more on your voice.

- Susan cannot attack you or react to the microphone from the moment you gain access to a weapon.

- Improved Susan's AI logic and randomized paths.[/i]

[h2][b][url=discord.gg/Xfd9RDecTp]JOIN DISCORD[/url][/b][/h2]

notes.title: SOLUTION FOR GAME CRASHES AND ERRORS
notes.content:
Day 2 without sleep, fixing and improving [b]Supernatural[/b], but it's worth it.


Many of you are experiencing game crashes due to memory issues and other strange UE5 error pop-ups. I have found a couple of solutions that should fix these issues.


[h2]SOLUTION #1[/h2]

[u]Right click on game app and go to properties:[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021401/3ffb977cb9fcd187a81666ca5e6e9e69ca33a3eb.png[/img]

[u]Then in the [b]LAUNCH OPTIONS[/b] type in [b]-dx11[/b]:[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021401/428682f356ead5330f821ee96a01c7848988d8b5.png[/img]

[h2]SOLUTION #2[/h2]

[u]The second solution is explained perfectly in this video. Many Discord members have stated that the solutions from the video worked for them for [b]Supernatural[/b]:[/u]
[previewyoutube=rZm90B93j-E;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][u]If these solutions worked for you, please consider updating your review. Thank you for your time, and I hope they help. If not, join our Discord, and I will try to assist you personally.[/u][/b]
